_comment: Copy to amazon_orders.local.json (not in git). dropFolders: where you save Amazon's Request Your Data ▸ Your Orders export — the zip as downloaded, or its Retail.OrderHistory.*.csv files unpacked (sub-folders are read too). srm.py load amazon-orders reads them and matches the orders to the Amazon card charges.

email._comment: srm.py load amazon-email: Amazon's order, shipment and refund e-mails from `since` on — from Gmail (read-only; connect it once with ./srm.py gmail-auth, the sign-in kept in the Keychain) unless gmail is false, and from Google Takeout .mbox files in the drop folders.
